instructions_to_main_agent: STRICT ADHERENCE TO SCREENSHOT REQUIREMENT: Do not add any creative liberties, external pages, sidebars, global headers, or dark mode.
USE ONLY .js/.jsx FILES. Do not use TypeScript (.tsx).
Layout requires a 70/30 split using CSS Grid (e.g., lg:grid-cols-10 with col-span-7 and col-span-3).
Left side must contain exactly 4 numbered sections: '1. Origin & Customer Details', '2. Product & Batch Identification', '3. Complaint Details', '4. Initial Assessment & Priority'.
Place 'Pending Triage' pill badge (amber-500 style) at the top of the form near the title.
Form inputs must have the placeholder 'Awaiting AI extraction...'.
At the bottom of the left column, include 'Reset Form' (outline) and 'Save Complaint' (solid blue-600) buttons.
Right column title: 'AI Complaint Intake Assistant' with a BETA badge (blue pill style) next to it.

Right column must feature a dashed upload zone, an 'OR Paste Complaint Text / Email' button, an emerald-50 info box detailing supported formats, a blue-600 animated progress bar, an AI message bubble, and a bottom chat input.
DO NOT use transparent backgrounds on containers. Use pure white (bg-white) for the two main columns to contrast against the off-white page background (bg-slate-50).
Include a `data-testid` attribute on all interactive and informational elements (buttons, inputs, dropzones) in kebab-case.
UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT: You tend to converge toward generic outputs. Avoid this: make distinctive frontends that perfectly execute the provided layout with high polish and attention to detail.
Dark colors look good when used independently without gradients. DO NOT use dark colors as gradients.
Create depth through layered design elements with z-index hierarchy and soft shadows (shadow-sm).
You MUST NOT apply universal transition (e.g., transition: all). Add transitions for specific interactive elements like button, input excluding transforms.
You MUST NOT center align the app container. Do not add .App { text-align: center; } in the CSS file.
Always use modern button styles (rounded-md) with interaction animations & color relevant to the app style.
NEVER use AI assistant Emoji characters like 🤖🧠💭💡🔮🎯 etc. for icons. Use lucide-react icons instead.
Every interaction needs micro-animations - hover states, input focus rings, transitions.
Prioritize using pre-existing components from src/components/ui when applicable.
Use sonner for toasts, located in /app/src/components/ui/sonner.jsx.
